connect._comment_existingInstanceArn: trackit-demo, created by hand in the us-west-2 console. CDK ADOPTS it. Leave instanceAlias blank: setting it makes CDK try to CREATE a second instance with an alias that is already taken, and the deploy fails minutes in.
connect._comment_storageConfigs: trackit-demo already has a CALL_RECORDINGS config from console creation; a second is rejected 409 AlreadyExists and fails the stack. Consequence of false: post-call analysis lands in the existing config's bucket, not ours, so the post-call index is never rebuilt until that config is repointed by hand.

benchmark._comment_arms: Add "bedrock-kb" once bedrockKnowledgeBaseId is filled in, and "moss" once MossSdkBindings are wired in src/moss/sdk-retriever.ts. An arm that cannot serve a call escalates every contact -- deliberate, but not what you want in a demo.
